active_color.description: Color of the current lyric line as it is sung
active_color.label: Active Color

color.description: Color of the surrounding lines and status messages
color.label: Color

font_size.description: Text size in pixels. Lines wider than the widget end with an ellipsis.
font_size.label: Font Size

hide_when_idle.description: Hide the widget while the player is paused or stopped
hide_when_idle.label: Hide When Idle

hide_when_no_media.description: Hide the widget when no media player is active
hide_when_no_media.label: Hide Without Media

line_count.description: Number of lyric rows, from 1 to 15
line_count.label: Visible Lines

shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the text
shadow.label: Shadow

sync_offset_ms.description: Positive values show lyrics earlier; negative values delay them. Milliseconds.
sync_offset_ms.label: Lyrics Sync Adjustment (ms)

width.description: Width of the lyric rows in pixels
width.label: Width
